wrongnetwork.title: Not Supported
wrongnetwork.text: Catalyst isn't supported on the network you've currently selected.

nostake.title: Not Registered
nostake.text: Your account isn't registered for staking. You'll need to delegate to a stake pool first, then you can register for Catalyst voting.

nocatalyst.title: No Catalyst Registration
nocatalyst.text: Eternl doesn't recognize your voting key. Your account might not have been registered, or it could have been registered with another app.

hascatalyst.title: Catalyst Registration
hascatalyst.text: Your account is registered for Catalyst voting. Your Catalyst voting key is stored right here in Eternl.
hascatalyst.scan: Scan the QR code in the Catalyst voting app and just follow the instructions.
hascatalyst.reveal: Don't share your Catalyst voting key and PIN with anyone. It's used to vote in Catalyst funding rounds.

banner.title: Download the QR Code
banner.text: We've stored a local backup of your Catalyst voting key here in Eternl in case you need to recover it. Keep in mind, though, this backup is specific to this device and won't be available if you restore your wallet on another device using your wallet phrase. Only a wallet JSON backup created *after* your Catalyst registration can restore it. We strongly recommend downloading the QR code image and storing it securely, like in a password manager.

app.title: Voting App
app.caption: Download the Catalyst mobile app to your phone.

notice.title: App Store Links!
notice.text:
NOT for use in the Catalyst mobile app!

These QR codes will take you to the app stores so you can download and install the Catalyst mobile app.

caption.enter: Set a PIN to keep your Catalyst voting key secure.

error.confirm: Your PINs don't match. Please try again.

warning.title: Write Down Your PIN
warning.text:
Make sure to write your PIN down!
If you lose your PIN, you'll need to register a new voting key.

tx.title: Voting Registration Transaction
tx.caption: Register your Catalyst voting key.

note.title: Voting Power
note.text: Your voting power scales with the amount of funds you hold at snapshot time. A higher balance means more influence during the snapshot.

warning.title: Minimum Amount
warning.text: You'll need a minimum balance of 25 {{currency}} for your voting key to be included in the snapshot. If you don't meet this minimum, you won't be able to vote or receive rewards in a funding round.

tx.saved: Catalyst voting key successfully saved in Eternl!

error.save: Failed to save Catalyst voting key in Eternl.
